definitionArtifact.contents: Exact static query definition from insight-get; no query results.

closedConditions.evaluatedPeriod: Previous complete UTC hour: toStartOfHour(now()) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
closedConditions.environment: resource_attributes deployment.environment.name OR deployment.environment equals production
closedConditions.lookback: Read definition selects 8 days of spans before evaluated_hour through the end of evaluated hour; baseline uses 7 days of observed covered hours before evaluated_hour.
closedConditions.routeWarmup: Baseline excludes each route's first partial hour. Query or byte branch requires at least 24 eligible baseline hours.
closedConditions.byteBreach: byte_covered_hours >= 24 AND current_byte_coverage >= 0.95 AND current_bytes > greatest(3 * median_bytes, 10000000)
closedConditions.byteBaselineEligibility: Zero estimated queries, or >=95% weighted queries with known numeric response_bytes_approx.
closedConditions.noCurrentTelemetry: row_value=NULL when no current service spans; evaluation suppressed by the query.
closedConditions.aggregate: max(row_value), plus aggregate count of breaching and evaluated sources.
closedConditions.attributionDefinitionOnly: Static definition includes validated request UUID, 16-hex user hash, allowlisted-shape RPC action, top-3 user/top-5 action aggregation, and unattributed counts. No rows or identifiers were queried.
closedConditions.byteMeaning: Estimated JSON response bytes from span attribute, not provider egress.
